items.t: Seminole County Clerk of Court systems targeted by cyberattack

items.t: Oviedo’s Bruder Brewery is a handsome pub with up-and-down grub
items.x: Bruder is an award-winning craft brewery with nearly a dozen locations in Colombia. This, its first stateside, exudes a thoughtfulness that suggests formula.

items.t: Orlando Maker Faire offers a full weekend of local innovation and creativity
items.x: Returning Nov. 7-8 to the Central Florida Fairgrounds for its 14th year, Maker Faire Orlando gathers artists, engineers, inventors and DIY enthusiasts to show off what they’ve been tinkering with.

items.x: The University of Central Florida was issued a $100K by the Big 12 over “discriminatory” chants performed by students at a football game.

items.t: ‘An attack on our community’: Orlando gay bars wiped from Instagram after Pride posts

items.x: More than 40 years after The Golden Girls first invited viewers into their Miami living room (and respective boudoirs!), Dorothy, Blanche, Rose and Sophia are back, but this time they’re in drag.

items.x: For his latest edition of Elfos, Marcos Morales selected credentialed Orlando saxophonist Ryan Devlin, who proves himself an inspired and disciplined foil.

items.x: Florida ranked as the third most aggressively gerrymandered state in the U.S. Florida's just behind Texas at No. 1 and California at No. 2.

items.t: Florida reveals new insurance rate drops effective this month
items.x: On Thursday, the Florida Office of Insurance Regulation announced new rate drops approved for insurance companies in the state — effective this month.
